lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 고운 선비가 길을 걸어가고 있었어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a kind scholar was walking along a road.
Tap the scholar, tap tap tap, to walk along!
Tap the scholar, tap tap tap! Walk along.
The scholar came to a big pine tree.

lines.text: 나무 위에서 까치 엄마가 울었어요. "까악 까악! 도와주세요!"
lines.en: Mama Magpie cried from the tree. Caw caw! Please help!
segs: Mama Magpie cried from the tree.

lines.text: 구렁이가 아기 까치 둥지로 스르르 올라가고 있어요!
lines.en: A snake was slithering up to the baby magpies' nest!
The scholar said, I will keep the baby magpies safe!
segs: I will keep the baby magpies safe!

lines.en: Tap the scholar! Shoot an arrow into the sky.

lines.text: 쉬익! 활 소리에 깜짝 놀란 구렁이는 숲으로 도망갔어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The snake was so surprised by the sound that it ran into the forest.

lines.text: 아기 까치들이 짹짹 울었어요. 아기 까치를 하나씩 세어 봐요!
lines.en: The baby magpies chirped. Let us count them one by one!
Tap the baby magpies, tap tap tap tap! Count them one by one.

lines.text: 아기 까치는 모두 네 마리예요. "선비님, 고맙습니다!"
lines.en: There were four baby magpies in all. Thank you, Mister Scholar!
segs: There were four baby magpies in all.

lines.en: Papa Magpie said, We will thank you for this one day!
segs: We will thank you for this one day!

lines.text: 선비는 컴컴한 산길을 걸었어요. 멀리 불빛이 반짝!
lines.en: The scholar walked a dark mountain path. Far away, a light twinkled!
Tap the scholar! Follow the light.

lines.text: 외딴집에서 아주머니가 나왔어요. "어서 오세요. 하룻밤 쉬어 가세요."
lines.en: A woman came out of a lonely house. Welcome. Please stay the night.
segs: A woman came out of a lonely house.

lines.text: 앗! 아주머니 치마 밑에 꼬리가 삐죽!
lines.en: Oh! A tail was poking out from under her skirt!
The woman was the same snake from the day before.

lines.text: 구렁이가 말했어요. "새벽까지 종이 세 번 울리면 보내 줄게. 하지만 종은 너무 멀어서 울릴 수 없을걸!"
lines.en: The snake said, If the bell rings three times by dawn, I will let you go. But the bell is too far to ring!
segs: If the bell rings three times by dawn, I will let you go. But the bell is too far to ring!

lines.en: The scholar was worried. What should I do?

lines.text: 달빛 아래에서 까치 아빠가 말했어요. "이번에는 우리가 도울 차례예요!"
lines.en: Under the moon, Papa Magpie said, Now it is our turn to help!
segs: Under the moon, Papa Magpie said,
Now it is our turn to help!

lines.en: Mama Magpie said, Everyone, fly to the bell!
Tap the magpie family! Fly together.

lines.text: 까치들이 종이 있는 곳까지 쌩쌩 날아갔어요.
lines.en: The magpies flew swiftly to the bell.

lines.text: 까치들이 머리로 종을 칠 거예요. 종을 톡톡톡 눌러서 세 번 울려 봐요!
lines.en: The magpies will ring the bell with their heads. Tap the bell, tap tap tap, to ring it three times!
Tap the bell, tap tap tap! Ring it three times.

lines.text: 댕, 댕, 댕! 종이 세 번 울렸어요.
lines.en: Dong, dong, dong! The bell rang three times.
The magpies were a little tired, but they were fine.
Dawn came. The snake heard the bell.

lines.text: 구렁이가 말했어요. "종이 세 번 울렸네! 약속대로 보내 줄게. 놀라게 해서 미안해."
lines.en: The snake said, The bell rang three times! I will keep my promise. I am sorry I scared you.
segs: The bell rang three times! I will keep my promise. I am sorry I scared you.

lines.en: The snake slithered back into the forest.

lines.text: 지친 까치 엄마 아빠가 쉬고 있어요.
lines.en: Mama and Papa Magpie were resting.
Tap the scholar! Give them water.
The scholar said, Thank you, magpies. Have a good rest!
segs: Thank you, magpies. Have a good rest!

lines.text: 아침 해가 떴어요. 아기 까치들도 날아왔어요.
lines.en: The morning sun rose. The baby magpies flew in too.
Everyone smiled together.
Tap the scholar! Hooray, all together!

lines.text: 서로 돕는 마음은 따뜻해요. 은혜 갚은 까치 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.
lines.en: Helping each other makes hearts warm. The story of the grateful magpie ended like this.

ui.서로 돕는 마음은 따뜻해요: Helping each other makes hearts warm
ui.서로 돕는 마음은 따뜻해요!: Helping each other makes hearts warm!
